criteria.description: RelayPool can atomically reconfigure normalized relay URLs in place, preserving retained relays, closing removed relays, adding new relays disconnected, and returning immutable URL snapshots.
Relay-settings hydration exposes a validated canonical snapshot callback so runtime topology consumers react to EVENT handling rather than polling shared config.

App relay topology convergence updates control-plane and service pools from canonical relay-settings snapshots while preserving sidecar precedence, Loom relay inclusion, and existing pools when topology-empty snapshots arrive.
Deterministic tests verify topology convergence without sleeps, polling, or config.Config mutation.
